label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

check.description: Identifies which check produced this result.

network.description: CAIP-2 id of the chain the payment settled on (e.g. eip155:8453 = Base).

error.description: Human-readable failure reason, or null on success.

listedCount.description: Number of blacklists the IP was found on.

sources.description: Comma-separated names of the blacklists that listed the IP, or null if clean.

status.description: UP = listed on 0 blacklists; WARN = listed on 1–2; DOWN = listed on 3 or more.

url.description: The normalized URL that was checked.

warning.description: Human-readable warning when the check passed but a threshold was crossed, else null.

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
